panels.title: Tokens consumed (5m, by provider)
panels.description: Tokens out of LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, RightCode). Sustained spike beyond budget = a tenant looped on /ai/generate; check the per-tenant panel below for the culprit.

panels.title: AI request rate (5m, by endpoint)
panels.description: Request volume to /ai/generate, /ai/explain, /ai/complete. /complete is the highest-traffic (autocomplete); the other two are user-initiated.

panels.title: BYOK cache hit rate
panels.description: We cache decrypted BYOK keys in process memory for 5min. < 80% hit rate = cache eviction pressure or AI traffic spread thin across many tenants.

panels.title: Circuit breaker state
panels.description: Per-provider breaker: 0=closed (healthy), 1=half-open (probing), 2=open (failing). Anything > 0 for >5 min = provider outage; ai-circuit-check cron auto-resets when healthy.

panels.title: Provider failure rate (5m)
panels.description: Per-provider error fraction. Persistent > 5% means the breaker will trip soon (see ai-circuit-check cron).

panels.title: Estimated cost / hour ($USD)
panels.description: Multiplies tokens by per-provider per-1k-tokens rate (loaded from ai_provider_pricing recording rule). If a tenant blows the AI budget, ai-anomaly-scan cron flags it within 1 hour.

panels.title: Top 10 tenants by AI token use (1h)
panels.description: Identifies the heavy hitters. If one org consumes > 50% of total, that's either healthy (enterprise) or a runaway loop (check their org for anomalies via ai-anomaly-scan).

panels.title: Anomaly detections (1h)
panels.description: Output of ai-anomaly-scan cron — counts tenants flagged for unusual usage (compared to their 7-day baseline). Auto-throttle kicks in if > 3x baseline sustained.

panels.title: AI request p99 latency (5m, by provider)
panels.description: Provider tail latency. OpenAI p99 typically 2-5s; Anthropic 3-8s; RightCode 1-3s. A 2x deviation means the provider is degraded (check their status page).

panels.title: Audit log emissions (logs)
panels.description: Every BYOK key use is audited. This tails the audit stream — use it to spot patterns during a security investigation.
